bends.note: west kerb jogs ~60 px (40 ft north of here, 50 ft south); centreline shifts ~30 px

ends.note: dead end at the south line of block 1 (Burnet Woods edge); Hopson does not continue north

notes: Printed names: 'LAKEWOOD AV. (GREENWOOD)', 'W. NIXON', 'HOPSON', 'BISHOP', 'IMPERIAL', 'JEFFERSON AV.', 'FOUNTAIN' (stub south of Lakewood); suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Bishop runs the full height and continues north onto 269 (it ends at Jefferson there). Nixon starts at Bishop (T) and crosses Jefferson (the east side opens onto 270). Imperial runs Lakewood-Nixon. A 15 ft unnamed alley slants from Nixon to Lakewood east of Imperial. Jefferson Av (60 ft) crosses the sheet diagonally NNW-SSE; at the top a 60 ft street branches NNE off its east side at ~(3116,668): it is unlabelled here but on 269 it continues NE and then N as the street printed 'CARTHAGE PIKE', so it is recorded as Carthage Pike (centre computed from the two kerb lines). Jefferson's crossing with Lakewood is just off the right edge (centre at x~6590), not picked. The Fountain/Lakewood and Imperial/Bishop/Hopson-Lakewood crossings are the same ones picked on 265.
